targets.query:
import "strings"

fieldSel = if "${feature}" == "" then "ALL" else "${feature}"
groupSel = if "${group}" == "" then "ALL" else "${group}"

ban = ["timestamp","LabviewTime","LabViewTime","StepNumber","Cycle"]

from(bucket: "iforest-analysis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iforest-analysis")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not contains(value: r._field, set: ban))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not strings.hasPrefix(v: r._field, prefix: "iforest_"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => fieldSel == "ALL" or r._field == fieldSel)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => groupSel == "ALL" or r.Group == groupSel)
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "_measurement", "iforest_status"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

groupSel = if "${group}" == "" then "ALL" else "${group}"

base =
  from(bucket: "iforest-analysis")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iforest-analysis")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => groupSel == "ALL" or r.Group == groupSel)

score =
  base
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "iforest_score")
    |> drop(columns: ["host", "_measurement", "iforest_status"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

threshold =
  base
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "iforest_threshold")
    |> drop(columns: ["host", "_measurement", "iforest_status"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

anomalies =
  base
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "iforest_score" and r.iforest_status == "anomaly")
    |> drop(columns: ["host", "_measurement", "iforest_status"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "iforest_anomaly_marker", _value: float(v: r._value) }))
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

union(tables: [score, threshold, anomalies])
  |> yield(name: "iforest_analysis")

list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "array"

all = array.from(rows: [{_value: "ALL"}])

groups =
  schema.tagValues(
    bucket: "source-data",
    tag: "Group",
    predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "source-data",
    start: 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z,
  )
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

union(tables: [all, groups])
  |> group()

list.definition:
import "array"
import "strings"

all = array.from(rows: [{_value: "ALL"}])

fields =
  from(bucket: "iforest-analysis")
    |> range(start: 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iforest-analysis")
    |> keep(columns: ["_field"])
    |> group()
    |> distinct(column: "_field")
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._value != "timestamp" and
      r._value != "LabViewTime" and
      r._value != "LabviewTime" and
      r._value != "StepNumber" and
      r._value != "Cycle" and
      not strings.hasPrefix(v: r._value, prefix: "iforest_")
    )
    |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

union(tables: [all, fields])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"])
